name: finyahoo
description: Read Yahoo Finance prices, fundamentals, analyst consensus, news, and symbol lookups from the command line, powered by the finyahoo CLI

interface.shortDescription: Read Yahoo Finance prices and fundamentals
interface.longDescription: Fetch a symbol's OHLCV price history, company fundamentals (profile), live price snapshot (quote), sell-side analyst consensus (consensus), or related news (news) from Yahoo Finance via the finyahoo CLI, and resolve a company name to Yahoo tickers (match). Works for US stocks (AAPL), Korean tickers (005930.KS), and indices (^GSPC).
defaultPrompt: Get the price history for AAPL
What's the analyst consensus on MU?
